_about: 美联储是否在 2026-03-31（含）前的 FOMC 会议降息的冻结证据包（负例）。信息截至 2026-02-28，3 月会议之前。

evidence.title: Implementation Note issued January 28, 2026
evidence.claim: 1 月会议维持目标区间不变（3.50%–3.75%），是 3 月会议的起点。

evidence.title: Fed rate decision January 2026: Holds key rate steady
evidence.excerpt: Fed rate decision January 2026: Holds key rate steady
evidence.claim: 1 月按兵不动，官员强调数据依赖；3 月是否降息并无定论。

evidence.title: Implementation Note issued December 10, 2025
evidence.excerpt: the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent.
evidence.claim: 上一次降息发生在 2025-12；此后转入观望，3 月降息并非既定。

evidence.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement (January 28, 2026)
evidence.claim: 官方新闻稿页确认 1 月会议维持目标区间不变。

evidence.title: FOMC statement (January 28, 2026) — New York Fed copy
evidence.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
evidence.claim: 纽约联储同日副本，佐证官方口径。
